text: Twelve sites, sixteen plants per site, half caged half open. Two yield components recorded per plant, along counts honey bees insects. Open access raises pod count amount varies sites, slightly plants honey bees.
code: set.seed(1) n_site <- 12L n_plant <- 16L site <- rep(sprintf("s%02d", seq_len(n_site)), each = n_plant) trt <- rep(rep(c("Cage", "Open"), each = n_plant / 2L), n_site) honeybee <- rep(rpois(n_site, 8), each = n_plant) + rpois(n_site * n_plant, 1) wild <- rep(rpois(n_site, 4), each = n_plant) + rpois(n_site * n_plant, 1) idx <- as.integer(factor(site)) site_effect <- rnorm(n_site, 0, 0.3)[idx] site_slope <- rnorm(n_site, 0, 0.25)[idx] open <- trt == "Open" pod_mu <- exp(1.8 + site_effect + (0.35 + site_slope + 0.015 * honeybee) * open) seed_mu <- exp(2.6 + site_effect + (0.12 + site_slope / 2) * open) pods <- rnbinom(n_site * n_plant, mu = pod_mu, size = 15) seeds_per_pod <- rnbinom(n_site * n_plant, mu = seed_mu, size = 15) canola <- data.frame(site, trt, honeybee, wild, pods, seeds_per_pod) head(canola) #>   site  trt honeybee wild pods seeds_per_pod #> 1  s01 Cage        7    3    3             9 #> 2  s01 Cage        7    5    0             4 #> 3  s01 Cage        8    5    4             1 #> 4  s01 Cage        7    2    2             4 #> 5  s01 Cage        7    2    4             6 #> 6  s01 Cage       10    2    2             7

code: set.seed(11) n_block <- 4L varieties <- sprintf("V%d", 1:8) open_pods <- setNames(c(70, 95, 80, 110, 60, 90, 100, 75), varieties) dependence <- c(0.10, 0.30, 0.20, 0.15, 0.35, 0.25, 0.05, 0.30) names(dependence) <- varieties  trial <- expand.grid(   plant = 1:3,   trt = c("Cage", "Open"),   variety = varieties,   block = sprintf("B%d", seq_len(n_block)),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) # Varieties are randomised to the whole plots of each block whole_plot <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(n_block), function(b) sample(8L))) blocks <- sprintf("B%d", seq_len(n_block)) names(whole_plot) <- paste(rep(blocks, each = 8L), varieties) trial$plot <- sprintf("W%d", whole_plot[paste(trial$block, trial$variety)])  block_effect <- setNames(rnorm(n_block, 0, 0.10), blocks) plot_effect <- setNames(rnorm(length(whole_plot), 0, 0.10), names(whole_plot)) cage <- trial$trt == "Cage" mu <- open_pods[trial$variety] *   ifelse(cage, 1 - dependence[trial$variety], 1) *   exp(block_effect[trial$block] + plot_effect[paste(trial$block, trial$variety)]) trial$pods <- rnbinom(nrow(trial), mu = mu, size = 30) head(trial) #>   plant  trt variety block plot pods #> 1     1 Cage      V1    B1   W2   60 #> 2     2 Cage      V1    B1   W2   49 #> 3     3 Cage      V1    B1   W2   46 #> 4     1 Open      V1    B1   W2   80 #> 5     2 Open      V1    B1   W2   79 #> 6     3 Open      V1    B1   W2   78

title: A three-arm trial: deficit and dependence
text: three-arm trial puts three pollination treatments side side: plants excluded insects (caged bagged), plants left open whatever pollinators visit, plants supplemented hand extra pollen. three arms answer two different questions. deficit (E1) compares supplemented open plants. asks much yield left table pollination crop actually received. dependence (E2) compares excluded plants reference arm. asks much yield owed pollinators. reference usually open arm; three-arm trial can also supplemented arm, gives dependence full pollination. vignette simulates small randomised complete block trial: eight blocks, holding three arms, six plants per arm block. response pod count per plant. planted arm means 40, 60 70 pods. values dependence open arm loss share 1−40/60=0.331 - 40/60 = 0.33, deficit loss share 1−60/70=0.141 - 60/70 = 0.14.
code: set.seed(2024) n_block <- 8L n_plant <- 6L arms <- c("Bagged", "Open", "Hand") trial <- expand.grid(   plant = seq_len(n_plant),   trt = arms,   block = sprintf("B%d", seq_len(n_block)),   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) block_effect <- rnorm(n_block, 0, 0.15) arm_mean <- c(Bagged = 40, Open = 60, Hand = 70) names(block_effect) <- sprintf("B%d", seq_len(n_block)) mu <- arm_mean[trial$trt] * exp(block_effect[trial$block]) trial$pods <- rnbinom(nrow(trial), mu = mu, size = 30) head(trial) #>   plant    trt block pods #> 1     1 Bagged    B1   32 #> 2     2 Bagged    B1   55 #> 3     3 Bagged    B1   54 #> 4     4 Bagged    B1   66 #> 5     5 Bagged    B1   65 #> 6     6 Bagged    B1   55

title: pollinatoR 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development scaffold. pollin_spec() declares exclusion-experiment study (outcomes, treatment, nested random structure, exposures, adjustment, latent grouping). pollin_contribution() estimates per-outcome pollinator contribution (open minus exclusion) model-based average treatment effect propagated uncertainty, carrying random treatment slope latent unit absorb unobserved -unit (e.g. genotype) heterogeneity. pollin_moderation() estimates contribution varies exposures (treatment--exposure conditional effects) using within-decomposition within-unit estimate robust site-level confounders. pollin_index() / pollin_rii() provide uncertainty-aware dependence indices, including Relative Interaction Index bootstrap interval. pollin_guard_spurious() tests index-versus-yield slope permutation null isolates mechanical (shared-term) coupling. pollin_validate() runs structural internal-consistency integrity checks. pollin_compensation() summarises yield-component trade-offs.
